result_summary: The E12-H64 attribution reproduces on a fixture with no ibm document. On the three Wergeland sections and their back-translation paraphrases (76 pooled statements, 3 positives, 12 negatives) the margin reads naive +15.84, arm a +55.83, arm b +14.45, full composition +54.74 closeness points, V 0/12 in all four. Centering plus re-L2-normalisation recovers 102.8% of the full-composition gain and the projection isolate -3.6% (ibm: 103.7% and -4.5%). cos(uncentered PC1, mean direction) is 0.999999 and no closeness is clipped (0/15 pairs). Conditioned-path reading, no bar: with the pre-pass replaced by arm a on the three ibm grounded triples the largest absolute closeness difference to the shipped pre-pass is 0.072559 (7.26 closeness points, adv2-b in gold|adv2-b) and d_sel is 0.330 to 0.493 times the shipped value with the order of the triples preserved, so arm a and the shipped pre-pass are not interchangeable on that path.
caveats: (1) The record registers 1e-6 for cost = sqrt(2 - 2cos) without naming the arithmetic; the notebook declared the E12-H64 reading (float64, exact-unit copies) before measuring, and it holds at 5.2e-08. Read on the float32 arrays the identity is off by 4.8e-04 to 7.7e-04 in every geometry, the shipped naive one included, so no arm causes it. (2) The 12 negative entries are 9 distinct document pairs because each base-against-base pair is scored once per anchor; margin and V do not depend on it, d' does. (3) One article: the sections share a subject, the positives are machine back-translations (naive closeness 0.8781 to 0.9071), only three positives exist, and the estimation pool is the scored pool as registered. (4) The conditioned-path reading covers three triples and one source and has no bar; it needed only the pre-pass built outside compute_source_conditioned with the internal one switched off (verified bit for bit against the shipped pre-pass and the saved baseline), so both closeness and d_sel are reported; grd_a and grd_b take statement texts, the pre-pass cannot reach them, and they were not recomputed. (5) The E12-H64 full-precision comparison rows are copied from the output of its registered run of 2026-09-01: another process rewrote the E12-H64 notebook and metrics file at 11:09 on 2026-10-09, in the same minutes as E07, E08 and other E12 notebooks and metrics files; this executor wrote none of them. (6) Autoreload is off in the notebook so that one fixed copy of the shipped code is scored.
